chapter: Lu Barker and the Barbarin family
title: Musicians in Lu's family
summary: Lu's father August DuPont, called Dimes, played sax, and relatives included a drummer cousin and clarinetist Gil Thomas.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Oh, that's wonderful. I wasn't aware of that. Was there anybody in your family that played music, Lu?
Oh yes. My ....(?).... played saxophone, my Daddy...

August Du Pont is his name. They called him Dimes. All the musicians would call him Dimes. He played. And my cousin Hersey(?), he played drums. And he has a son, they call him Bib, but his right name is [INDECIPHERABLE]
He plays drums, too. And I have a cousin named...
...Thompson...Thomas... Gil Thomas, yes. They call him Brother Cornbread.
